rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Prosody message
Jitsi Meet: Prosody message (docker json-file log)
Jitsi Meet: Jicofo, Videobridge, Jibri or Jigasi message
Jitsi Meet: Jicofo, Videobridge, Jibri or Jigasi message (docker json-file log)
Jitsi Meet: stack trace or browser output line
Jitsi Meet: JWT verification failed
Jitsi Meet: expired JWT presented

rule.regex: reason:(?:Invalid signature|Invalid or incorrect alg|Algorithm not supported|Invalid typ|Invalid token|Invalid header|Invalid body|bad token format|invalid 'iss' claim|'iss' claim is missing|invalid 'aud' claim|'aud' claim is missing|'kid' claim|'alg' claim is missing|exp must be number|nbf must be number|sub claim is missing|room claim is missing)
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: JWT rejected as not signed by this server or malformed
Jitsi Meet: connection without a JWT refused (meeting opened without the portal)

rule.regex: reason:(?:could not obtain public key|signature verification key is missing)
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: JWT verification key unavailable (ASAP key server or secret), every join fails

rule.regex: reason:(?:Not acceptable by nbf|jwt missing required context claim)
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: JWT not yet valid or without its context claim (clock skew between portal and server?)

rule.regex: Token \S+ not allowed to join:
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: JWT not valid for the room it tried to create or join

rule.regex: Error verifying token on (?:pre|post) authentication stage
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: JWT rejected by a pre or post authentication check

rule.regex: user is banned|User is banned room:
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: banned user refused
[WARN] Jitsi Meet: repeated JWT failures (forgery attempts, or a portal secret that no longer matches)
Jitsi Meet: recording or live stream refused, participant not allowed
Jitsi Meet: recording or live stream requests over the rate limit

rule.match: is not moderator and not allowed this operation
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: participant without moderator role tried to end the meeting for all
Jitsi Meet: dial-out refused, participant not allowed

rule.regex: Rejecting join with invalid MUC resource|Rejecting anonymous user: MUC resource
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: join with a crafted MUC resource refused

rule.regex: due to login/join rate exceeded|Join rate exceeded for
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: address over the XMPP login or join rate limit

rule.regex: Created new account \S+ by |Password of account \S+ changed by |User \S+ has been (?:deleted|disabled|enabled) by |Server being shut down by |mod_\S+ (?:loaded|unloaded|reloaded|globally unloaded) by |User account created: |reloads the config
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: XMPP account or server administration

rule.regex: No available SASL mechanisms|All SASL mechanisms provided by authentication module|'app_id' must not be empty|'app_secret', 'asap_key_server or 'cacheKeysUrl' must be specified|no token configuration but it is required|option set, denying access
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Prosody authentication is misconfigured, logins fail
Jitsi Meet: token authentication accepts connections without a token
Jitsi Meet: external XMPP component failed to authenticate

rule.match: SASL succeeded but username was invalid
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: login accepted by the auth module with an invalid user name

rule.regex: SSL/TLS: Failed to load|SSL/TLS: Error initialising for|Error creating contexts? for (?:c2s|s2sout|s2sin)|No TLS context available for|Error creating TLS context for SNI host|Error reloading certificate for|Encrypted certificate for \S+ requires
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Prosody TLS certificate or key error

rule.regex: Failed to open server port|Error binding encrypted port|Failed to activate service|Multiple services configured to listen on the same port
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Prosody could not open a listening port

rule.regex: Room limit of \d+ reached|Attempt to enter a maxed out room
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: room or participant limit reached

rule.regex: Ping failed, the XMPP connection needs to reconnect|connectionClosedOnError#\d+: Closed on error:|XMPP connection closed on error:
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: component lost its XMPP connection

rule.regex: getConnectAndLoginCallable\S*: Error connecting:|reconnectionFailed#\d+: Reconnection failed:|Failed to connect/login: |Failed to connect: .* will re-try|XMPP reconnection failed:
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: component cannot reach its XMPP server (retrying)
[WARN] Jitsi Meet: component has not reached its XMPP server for minutes

rule.match: Failed to login. Disconnecting to trigger a re-connect
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: component XMPP login refused (wrong or changed account password)

rule.regex: Disabling certificate verification!|Disabling TLS certificate verification!
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: component connects to XMPP without verifying the server certificate
Jitsi Meet: Jicofo lost a videobridge
[WARN] Jitsi Meet: no operational videobridge, meetings have no audio or video
Jitsi Meet: every videobridge is shutting down

rule.match: Failed to select bridge for participantProperties
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: no videobridge could be selected for a participant
Jitsi Meet: Jicofo marked a videobridge as failing ICE
Jitsi Meet: health check failed
[WARN] Jitsi Meet: health checks keep failing

rule.match: Allowing to expire because ICE failed.
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: participant media connection (ICE) failed
Jitsi Meet: several participants failed ICE (media port or TURN unreachable)
Jitsi Meet: videobridge shutdown requested

rule.regex: startFileRecording#\d+: Starting a file recording
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: recording started
Jitsi Meet: live stream started
Jitsi Meet: Jibri SIP gateway started

rule.regex: stopService#\d+: Stopping the current service
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: recording or stream stopped

rule.regex: StatefulJibriService\.onServiceStateChange#\d+: .* service transitioning from state .+ to Error
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: recording or stream failed

rule.regex: Health status has changed: \w+ -\x3e UNHEALTHY
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Jibri reports itself unhealthy

rule.regex: Unable to write to /|Unable to write metadata file to recording directory
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Jibri cannot write to the recordings directory

rule.match: Finalizing the jibri service operation using command [/path/to/finalize,
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Jibri finalize script is the unconfigured placeholder
Jitsi Meet: Jibri could not run the recording finalize script
Jitsi Meet: Jibri finalize script not configured (placeholder path)

rule.regex: Finalize script finished with exit value [1-9]
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: Jibri finalize script failed

rule.regex: Failed to start a Jibri session, no Jibris available|Unable to find an available Jibri, can't start|Jibri start request timed out|Failed to start a Jibri session:
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: recording requested but no Jibri could start it

rule.match: Failed to start a Jibri session, all Jibris were busy
rule.description: Jitsi Meet: recording requested while every Jibri was busy
Jitsi Meet: recording request from a participant without moderator role ignored
Jitsi Meet: lobby turned off in a meeting
Jitsi Meet: signalling endpoint answered with a gateway error
[WARN] Jitsi Meet: Prosody or videobridge unreachable behind the web server
